registered_before: any fit, score or prediction of this lane

part_A_G4.base: G3 as frozen at 91def7c4 (docs/reports/data/2026-11-03-q139q-gemm-g3/g3_model.py): P0 levels, E119 burst-cap dither 66.15 +- 2.75 W, trip on G3's grid, Q138(t) aifoundry2 chain, OFF_SHARE 0.5, dt 0.2 s, 20 s anchor, window = in-kernel samples of the last 40 s

terms_in_order.name: T_Z
terms_in_order.what: Q140(l)'s zeros level: every level + beta x delta_t

terms_in_order.name: T_D
terms_in_order.what: one die law: level = P0(f) [+ beta delta] + k_D (T(t) - T_ref), replacing G3's k_eff (T - T_start)

terms_in_order.name: T_G
terms_in_order.what: the governor's process-boundary and in-process steps folded into one dip at each process's kernel start: d_G x the process's kernel seconds at 618 MHz when L800(T) >= P_G

terms_in_order.name: T_S
terms_in_order.what: M8's span fraction for other kinds (structural, not selected): S(k) = S(zeros) + phi_k (S(top) - S(zeros)), phi_k = D_M8(k) / D_M8(top) at 600 MHz on aifoundry3's footing

part_A_G4.rows: the 56 runs of posthoc-g3-inputs.json (E119, E126, E136, E146) + E159's 9 holds rebuilt on e159_g3.score's path: 65 runs, 5 sessions
part_A_G4.folds: leave one session out; every constant chosen inside each fold on the other four sessions
part_A_G4.forward_rule: A0 = G3 nested; T_Z, T_D, T_G added in order to the model kept so far; a term carries if the held-out loss falls in >= 3 of 5 sessions and pooled; kept if it carries; G4 = G3 + kept + T_S, constants then chosen on all five sessions and frozen
part_A_G4.scored: per held-out session and pooled: window clock, board, die (rms, mean, inside 15 MHz / 2 W / 1 C); arms G3 as frozen, G3 nested, E136's law, the chain on the measured trace; paired bootstrap of G3 nested - G4 nested rms over runs (10,000)
reported_checks: E158's 42 zeros bursts' p800 vs P0 + beta delta + k_D (T_start - T_ref)
E159's three zeros holds' window spread
E136's four other-kind runs with T_S vs E136's law

E168_design.hold: 12 processes of --seconds 8 (budget 9.5, tail 6), about 106 s, last 40 s read
E168_design.primary: G4 mechanical from each hold's own measured start (e159_g3.score's path); T_Z on the fallback unless the session ran kinds zeros anchors (then a second arm)

E168_rules.increment_rule: int8 W8A8 real and int8 sparse50 at S2, window board minus int8 zeros at S2, within 15% of G4's frozen 800 MHz level span int8 full - int8 zeros at S2 at the hold's window die

part_A_G4.peak_rule: P0(800) + 8.51 W <= 82 W (G3's frozen rule, no level term); else duty-cycled or dropped; stops board > 85 W on 3 live samples or die >= 76 C

part_B_stride.mapping: L3 shire PA[10:6], bank PA[12:11], sub-bank PA[14:13], set PA[22:15] (256 sets at 32 MB), 4 ways, true LRU assumed; tile set = tile address bits [22:10], 8192 sets x 4 ways of 1 KB tiles
part_B_stride.offsets: C at 0, A at C's size, B at C's + A's size (runtime first-fit, host order out, a, b)
part_B_stride.term_SM: E146's l3_steps with the set-mapped L3; E146's split(); MAB's frozen prices; T(f) = C/f + M through 600 and 800 MHz; no constant fitted
sensitivity_arms: A's lines from the L3 as E158, only B from SM
part_B_stride.dram_term: not registered: no public source found for the PA-to-memshire interleave

scored_committed.S1: SM rms on E146's 24 cells and E158's 22 rungs vs ISO (10.6% out of sample / 4.6% in sample) and STRICT
scored_committed.S2: SM within 3% on K6n4, K4n8, D4, D8
scored_committed.S3: SM's far-B share vs E158's measured share per rung

part_B_stride.E169_rules: SM's frozen T800 within 3% on every shape (fp32 zeros bursts, launches >= 790 MHz); resolved on each power-of-two shape: |T_SM - T_ISO| / T_ISO >= 3% and measured closer to SM than to ISO
